name: Delta Air Lines
outlook:
What Delta Air Lines says to expect

  • December quarter 2026: earnings per shareIn the December quarter, we expect earnings of $1.15 to $1.65 per share, based on a fuel price of approximately $4.25 per gallon.
  • December quarter 2026: total revenueRevenue momentum is continuing in the December quarter, with strength across all products and geographies, supporting our outlook for total revenue growth of approximately 20 percent over last year.
  • Full year 2026: pre-tax profitFor the full year, we expect to generate a pre-tax profit of roughly $4.5 billion, absorbing a $6 billion increase in fuel costs.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 9, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
